channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-18556 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 67. N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-56164 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-116606 — Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

item.title: CVE-2026-81963 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2026-111560 — Barracuda Networks Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

item.title: CVE-2022-0609 — Google Chromium Animation
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium Animation contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-1956 — Apache Kylin
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Apache Kylin contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could permit an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-24990 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Agere Modem Driver contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain administrator privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH
item.description: Threat Signal 69. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 81. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-41709 — Broadcom VMware ESX
item.description: Threat Signal 52. Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

item.title: CVE-2019-15107 — Webmin Webmin
item.description: Threat Signal 90. An issue was discovered in Webmin. The parameter old in password_change.cgi contains a command injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2019-11043 — PHP FastCGI Process Manager (FPM)
item.description: Threat Signal 90. In some versions of PHP in certain configurations of FPM setup, it is possible to cause FPM module to write past allocated buffers allowing the possibility of remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-2861 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 90. A directory traversal vulnerability exists in the administrator console in Adobe ColdFusion which allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files.

item.title: CVE-2012-4681 — Oracle Java SE
item.description: Threat Signal 90. The Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle Java SE allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2012-0507 — Oracle Java SE
item.description: Threat Signal 90. An incorrect type vulnerability exists in the Concurrency component of Oracle's Java Runtime Environment allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2020-0796 — Microsoft SMBv3
item.description: Threat Signal 90. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the Microsoft Server Message Block 3.1.1 (SMBv3) protocol handles certain requests. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could gain the ability to execute code on the target server or client.

item.title: CVE-2021-20038 — SonicWall SMA 100 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 90. SonicWall SMA 100 devies are vulnerable to an unauthenticated stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability where exploitation can result in code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-2725 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Injection vulnerability in the Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent: Web Services).

item.title: CVE-2021-44228 — Apache Log4j2
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-42013 — Apache HTTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Apache HTTP Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution if files outside directories configured by Alias-like directives are not under default require all denied or if CGI scripts are enabled. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2021-41773.

item.title: CVE-2021-41773 — Apache HTTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Apache HTTP Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution if files outside directories configured by Alias-like directives are not under default �require all denied� or if CGI scripts are enabled. The original patch issued under this CVE ID is insufficient, please review remediation information under CVE-2021-42013.

item.title: CVE-2017-5638 — Apache Struts
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser allows for malicious file upload using the Content-Type value, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-26084 — Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Server contain an Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2019-3396 — Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability that may allow an attacker to achieve path traversal and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-19781 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-7600 — Drupal Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Drupal Core contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site, resulting in complete site compromise.

item.title: CVE-2021-22205 — GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
item.description: Threat Signal 90. GitHub Community and Enterprise Editions that utilize the ability to upload images through GitLab Workhorse are vulnerable to remote code execution. Workhorse passes image file extensions through ExifTool, which improperly validates the image files.

item.title: CVE-2020-5902 — F5 BIG-IP
item.description: Threat Signal 90. F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) contains a remote code execution vulnerability in undisclosed pages.

item.title: CVE-2021-22986 — F5 BIG-IP and BIG-IQ Centralized Management
item.description: Threat Signal 90. F5 BIG-IP and BIG-IQ Centralized Management contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the iControl REST interface that allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to execute system commands, create or delete files, and disable services.

item.title: CVE-2021-35464 — ForgeRock Access Management (AM)
item.description: Threat Signal 90. ForgeRock Access Management (AM) Core Server allows an attacker who sends a specially crafted HTTP request to one of three endpoints (/ccversion/Version, /ccversion/Masthead, or /ccversion/ButtonFrame) to execute code in the context of the current user (unless ForgeRock AM is running as root user, which the vendor does not recommend).

item.title: CVE-2018-13379 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN web portal contains a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to download FortiOS system files through specially crafted HTTP resource requests.

item.title: CVE-2021-38647 — Microsoft Open Management Infrastructure (OMI)
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Microsoft Open Management Infrastructure (OMI) within Azure VM Management Extensions contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-0708 — Microsoft Remote Desktop Services
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Microsoft Remote Desktop Services, formerly known as Terminal Service, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to connect to the target system using RDP and send specially crafted requests. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of BlueKeep.

item.title: CVE-2019-0604 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Microsoft SharePoint fails to check the source markup of an application package. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run remote code in the context of the SharePoint application pool and the SharePoint server farm account.

item.title: CVE-2019-18935 — Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

item.title: CVE-2019-11510 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.

item.title: CVE-2019-5544 — VMware VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-22005 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2021-21972 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2021-21985 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-40539 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-24423 — SmarterTools SmarterMail
item.description: Threat Signal 89. SmarterTools SmarterMail contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in the ConnectToHub API method. This could allow the attacker to point the SmarterMail instance to a malicious HTTP server which serves the malicious OS command and could lead to command execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-52691 — SmarterTools SmarterMail
item.description: Threat Signal 89. SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to any location on the mail server, potentially enabling remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-5777 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 89. Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability due to insufficient input validation. This vulnerability can lead to memory overread when the NetScaler is configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2024-53704 — SonicWall SonicOS
item.description: Threat Signal 89. SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the SSLVPN authentication mechanism that allows a remote attacker to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2024-55591 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 89. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted requests to Node.js websocket module.

item.title: CVE-2024-55956 — Cleo Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 89. Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to import and execute arbitrary bash or PowerShell commands on the host system by leveraging the default settings of the Autorun directory.

item.title: CVE-2024-51378 — CyberPersons CyberPanel
item.description: Threat Signal 89. CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and the execution of arbitrary commands using shell metacharacters in the statusfile property.

item.title: CVE-2024-0012 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 89. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web-based management interface for several PAN-OS products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.
